title: A lively and engaging guided tour of Seville
text: We opted for a tour of the main sights and a visit of the muséum of fine arts. Carmen led us through the winding maze of Seville’s Jewish quarter (among other sights), taking us on a journey through the history of the city and Spain as we explored its streets. She wove in a wealth of fascinating anecdotes and literary, film and musical references, making the tour lively, engaging and informative, and inspiring us to continue our discoveries once we returned to France.
